name: Fiat redemption

subjectOf.text: The absence of fiat par-redemption combined with limited acceptance inside merchant ecosystems makes LER rewards closed-loop utilities, which is what removes their classification as electronic money tokens or securities.
subjectOf.abstract: Third, the absence of fiat par-redemption and limited acceptance within merchant ecosystems positions LER voucher loyalty rewards as closed-loop utilities. This removes their classification as electronic money tokens (EMTs) or securities, which, in turn, simplifys compliance.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
scope_conditions: no redemption at par in fiat

subjectOf.text: A favorable legal assessment of LER depends on four design features holding simultaneously: non-transferability, absence of a secondary market, absence of fiat redemption, and consumptive utility.
subjectOf.abstract: Most important for a favorable legal assessment is LER non-transferability, no secondary market, no fiat redemption, and consumptive utility.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
